FINAL DEPLOYMENT BLOCKER

GitHub HEAD is ahead of the production runtime.

Do not perform additional feature development until deployment synchronization is complete.

1. Identify why the latest GitHub commit has not reached production.
2. Check whether Render auto-deploy is enabled.
3. If a deployment failed, provide the build logs and exact error.
4. Trigger or complete deployment of the latest GitHub HEAD.
5. Verify that:
   - GitHub HEAD SHA
   - Render runtime SHA
   - /health commit
   - /version commit
   all match exactly.
6. Rebuild and verify the APK if backend changes affect the app.
7. After synchronization, execute fresh production tests for:
   - Owner login
   - Member registration
   - Member login
   - Investment APIs
   - Payment endpoints
8. Do not mark deployment COMPLETE until all runtime SHAs match and live tests pass.
